stem.en: Is each statement about checker training true or false?

text.en: A checker marks only the final answer, not each step of the working.
Checker training happens while you chat, so the model improves as you use it.
Maths and code improved first partly because a computer can mark them.
A checker can mark most facts about the world in the same easy way.

explanation.en: A checker uses an answer key or tests, so it marks only the final answer. Working that reached a right answer gets nudged up in training, and using the model changes no setting. Sums and programs can be marked by a machine, but most facts about the world cannot.

hints.en: Ask when the nudging happens, and what a machine is able to mark.
